items.title: Toshiko Akiyoshi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999
items.q: Rudy Willliams, who used to be with Lionel Hampton

ctx.x: Yes. The first great pianist I had met actually in person was Oscar Peterson. That was in 1953 I believe. That was the first time the American jazz group came to Japan for the Japanese audience. Before that a few groups came to Japan but they were for the USO

tour for the American troops. For example, Louis Armstrong was there one time, and the Gene Krupa Trio was there one time, and way before that, in 1950 I believe there was a dance band, Les Brown’s band with Bob Hope. But more than anything, I think ’51, I’m not quite sure, there is Oscar Pettiford the leader, and J.J. Johnson and Howard McGhee, they were also on the USO tour.
